cases.name: Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc.
UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Suno is a for-profit startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Its site presents it as an AI music generator: a user describes a genre, mood, theme, or lyrics, and Suno builds a complete track with vocals, instrumentation, and production, which the company says takes under a minute. It also offers Suno Studio, which it describes as a web-based generative audio workstation combining traditional DAW functionality with AI-powered music creation. Paid tiers are described as Pro, with 500 songs a month, royalty free music, access to v5.5, commercial use rights, priority generation, the Song Editor, stem separation into vocal and instrument stems, and audio uploads of up to 8 minutes, and Premier, with 2,000 songs a month, Suno Studio, a multitrack editor, MIDI export, Persona Voices, and early access to new features. A free tier is described as free forever.

The company describes itself as the market-leading and number one AI music generator, and says millions of people use it for fun, for content, and for professional projects. It contrasts its output with what it says most AI music generators produce, short instrumental loops, and positions its models as producing full songs across every genre.

The litigation record for Suno lists eight cases. UMG Recordings, Sony Music et al. v. Suno, Inc. was filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts, where Rugnetta v. Suno, Inc., Pilavian v. Suno, Inc., Reyna v. Suno, and S.A. Jamendo v. Suno Inc. were also filed. Gawronski v. Suno Inc. was filed in the District Court for the Southern District of Texas, Poseidon Wave Media LLC v. Suno, Inc. in the Southern District of New York, and Woulard v. Suno, Inc. in the Northern District of Illinois. Massachusetts carries the largest share of that exposure, with a count of 187. Suno's tracked product is its music generation service, where intellectual property provenance is noted as relevant.
